uddisati.cp: u + dis + a. points out; appoints; allots; recites.
uddisati.p: [U+disa(dīsa)+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (A) They preach and chant. (It includes both two that a teacher chants for his disciple to learn, and a disciple chants at the present teacher as learning). (B) It instructs. (C) One aim at a person and expresses one's wish that person may also acquire the benefit from one's meritorious deed equally.
